items.headline: Coinbase began enabling trades in Indian rupees, expanding access for users in India
Coinbase and Kalshi launched regulated perpetual crypto futures for U.S. investors on domestic exchanges
New York’s attorney general sued Coinbase Financial Markets and Gemini Titan over prediction market operations, alleging illegal gambling under state law
The CFTC filed a lawsuit against New York, saying the state’s actions against Coinbase Financial Markets and others infringed on its authority to regulate prediction markets
